operations.title: The Betti boundary obstruction is basis-invariant
operations.statement: For Omega_n=D_H,n S_n-S_(n-1)D_G,n, invertible source and target basis changes give Omega'_n=P_H,n-1^(-1) Omega_n P_G,n. Thus vanishing, field rank, and integral Smith factors are intrinsic.

operations.title: Coordinate-free boundary-obstruction witness
operations.procedure: Exhibit x in C_n(G) and lambda in C_(n-1)(H)^* and evaluate lambda(Omega_n x).
operations.falsifier: Any nonzero value falsifies the forced chain map independently of bases.
operations.caution: Nonzero reduction modulo a prime proves integral failure; zero reduction at one prime does not prove integral vanishing.
